summary: thiscall cleanup helper: loads the object handle at this[7] (this+0x1C) and, when non-null, invokes the object's vtable entry 0 with argument 1, then clears this[7] to 0 and returns the call result. Prior skeleton analysis (DERIVED only) interprets this as StopAndReleaseOwnedObject — releasing a owned object.

local_names.v2: object handle loaded from this+0x1C; also the vtable pointer used to reach the indirect call
local_names.result: return value of the vtable[0] call; uninitialized when the null guard fails

operations.description: Load this[7] (this+0x1C) into v2 as the owned object handle
Guard on v2: when null, skip the call and the clear, returning the (uninitialized) result
Indirect call through vtable entry 0 of the owned object with argument 1: v2->vtable[0](v2, 1)
Clear this[7] (this+0x1C) to 0, dropping the owned object handle
Return the result of the vtable[0] call

unresolved: Identity of vtable entry 0 and the meaning of argument 1 are unknown; prior skeleton analysis proposes stop/release semantics (DERIVED only, not runtime-confirmed).
result is uninitialized when the null guard fails; the null-handle path returns an indeterminate value.
ABI legacy name 'Short_Computation_4c9960' is not corroborated by packet evidence.
